Definition: from G5219; attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission:--obedience, (make) obedient, obey(-ing).
BiblicalUsage: The word hypakoḗ carries the sense of obedience, (make) obedient, obey(-ing). In Romans 1:5, the text says "for obedience to the faith among all nations." In 2 Corinthians 7:15, the text says "whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hypakoḗ shows us that obedience is not drudgery; it is trusting that God's way is the good way. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Titus Brings News from Corinth; Onesimus Returns to Philemon
